description: Llamada entrante a Floridian Poodle Vet. Camila (agente) atiende a Jennifer por la cojera de su perro Max.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Floridian Poodle Vet, this is Camila speaking, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, yeah, um, I'm a little worried about my dog. He's been limping a little on his back leg since this morning, but he's still eating and playing, so I don't think it's an emergency, but I wanted to check.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I completely understand wanting to get that checked out, better safe than sorry. Can I ask, is he putting any weight on it at all, or is he avoiding it completely?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, he's putting weight on it, he's just favoring it a little.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, that's helpful to know. Since he's still eating and moving around normally, it doesn't sound like an emergency, but we definitely want a vet to take a look soon just to rule anything out. Can I get his name and yours?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, it's Max, and I'm Jennifer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thank you Jennifer. We actually have an opening tomorrow morning at nine fifteen with Doctor Alvarez, would that work for you and Max?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's perfect, thank you so much.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. I'll get that booked for you right now. Can I just confirm the best number to reach you at?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yeah, it's three oh five, five five five, zero one four eight.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect, you're all set for tomorrow at nine fifteen with Doctor Alvarez. You'll get a text confirmation in a moment. Try to keep him resting tonight if you can, and we'll take good care of him tomorrow.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you so much, I feel a lot better now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, that's what we're here for. See you both tomorrow, Jennifer.

note: Guion original. El audio en produccion se genero con ElevenLabs (voz Amy), no con este script.
